prototypeDesigns.GER-1: Closed steep modern bowl: three-tier main stand (two glass hospitality bands, glass-lounge podium, directors' box), two-tier ends, curved filled corners, one ring roof (cantilever, curved 'smiling' edge), roof light rails, no masts, ramp towers; TV tower and Alps (haze). Home: lower tier of the x+ end with drop banners; visitors: upper-tier centre of the x- end.
prototypeDesigns.GER-5: Four separate stands hung from four lit brick corner towers by truss girders (cables from the towers); raised brick-arcade main stand with the players' tunnel; Rhine with a three-arch steel bridge behind the right end, twin-spire cathedral (haze) behind the far stand. Home: standing x- terrace, visitors' pen in the far corner of x+.
prototypeDesigns.GER-6: Small inner-city ground: short (72 %) timber main stand with a gabled roof on front columns, clock turret, open terraces hemmed in by apartment blocks, covered home terrace on x-, four lattice pylons, scoreboard tower in the far-right corner, church spire.
prototypeDesigns.GER-2: Riverside ground closed only on the far side: barrel-vaulted roofs on both long stands (truss front), far corners curved, near corners open, steep open kop on x+ (home, full end, 60 flags), cantilever-covered x- end with the visitors' pen in its far corner, four tall slim corner masts, river quay with a moored ship behind the kop, windmill and gabled brick houses behind the far stand.
prototypeDesigns.GER-3: Shipyard sheds: raised main stand on a brick plinth with roller doors under a saw-tooth roof on front columns, gabled near stand, open standing x- terrace (home), saw-tooth x+ stand on a front truss with the visitors' segment, four open corners showing warehouses, lattice pylons with bar heads, gantry crane behind x+, harbour cranes and church spire behind the far stand.
prototypeDesigns.CUP-STANDARD-GER: Compact community ground: short covered main stand (cantilever) on a podium, three low open terraces, six side poles, turnstile blocks, scoreboard tower, park; home central block on x-, visitors' corner on x+.
prototypeDesigns.NEUTRAL-EUROPE: Final arena: three-tier bowl with curved corners, cantilever ring roof with curved edges, a great arch over the far stand carrying the roof front on hangers, ramp towers, city blocks and river; the team flagged home in the lower tier of x-, the other in the lower tier of x+ (equal).

whatChanged.generator: StadiumArchitecture is one identity-driven generator (stand forms/tiers/podiums/directors' boxes/crush barriers/flanks, nine roof kinds with supports and edges, four corner forms, four floodlight kinds with four lamp heads, entrances, sixteen landmark kinds, ten surroundings, supporter block reservation and visitors' fences). Legacy archetype constants remain the base for gaps, rake and palette; legacy-derived identities reproduce the Release 130 pieces exactly. Appended StadiumSlot.Haze (distant silhouettes; earlier slots keep their order); StadiumPiece gains sides (prism side count) and detail (reduced-quality drop flag).
whatChanged.supporters: StadiumSupporters.Plan(stadium, setup, detailed): per reserved block standing low-poly figures (legs, body, head; 40 % raised arms, some scarves) on every row clear of the aisles, flags on poles held from the second row on (>= 2.2 m apart, four designs from a per-club atlas), banners on the block front (fence), hung from the tier above (drop) or one long banner. Colours: presentation.clubs primary/secondary (kits only without presentation, which builds no supporters at all), slightly muted below the kits. Budgets: standard <= 96 flags / 24 banners, reduced <= 32 / 12; reduced keeps every figure (same block silhouette) without legs, arms and scarves. Meshes: one figure mesh (figures + poles) and one cloth mesh (flags + banners, club atlas) per block, parented to the block's stand side, shadow casting off, receiving on, bounds inflated by 4.4/4.6 m.
whatChanged.motion: D6Flag.shader (Doppel6/Supporters): ripple along the cloth, swing about the hands around the axis toward the pitch, coherent bounce with arm pumping; uniforms _D6PresentTime = displayed frame clock mod 600 s (StadiumSupporters.PresentTime) and _D6Celebrate (only the scoring club's block, envelope of celebrationTime), set per frame in UpdateSupporters from the displayed frame. Frequencies 1.8/.55/1.35 Hz are multiples of 1/600 Hz (seamless wrap); phases: per block from FNV(club|block|side) with +-.06 cycle per figure, per flag from FNV(club|flag|index). No _Time, Time.*, Random or integrated state: pause, replay, review and seek reproduce the picture for the same clock; frame.turned is never read. UnityPerMaterial CBUFFER (SRP batcher).
whatChanged.lightLookConsumption: Read-only, built once per load after ApplyMatchLighting: sky dome texture = SkyTexel(look) (night values reproduce Release 130 exactly), lamp emission (1.6,1.5,1.3).linear * lampEmission, windows lit when grain > windowLit and the look is not Day (lighting lane: day windowLit 1), glass emission calmer by day, crowd _BaseColor = white * crowdLight, supporter figures _D6Light = crowdLight, flags/banners _D6Light = bannerLight, Haze colour = lerp(skyHorizon, skyGround, .45) (material only created when a plan has haze pieces). Verified against lane B's handoff semantics (windowLit threshold, day lampEmission 0, crowdLight .86, bannerLight .92); supporter renderers set ShadowCastingMode.Off themselves (ApplyMatchShadows runs before BuildSupporters).

fingerprint.definition: StadiumBlueprint.StructuralFeatures(): 11 declared groups from the identity (stands, asymmetry, roofs, supports, corners, floodlights, landmarks, facade, entrances, surroundings, supporters) plus 2 measured groups from the built pieces (heights: rotation-aware tops of non-detail pieces per side in 1.5 m bands; skyline: far and end skylines in 6 m bands). Silhouette groups: stands, asymmetry, roofs, supports, corners, floodlights, landmarks, heights, skyline. StadiumFingerprint.Distance counts differing groups. Colours, names, IDs, seeds and tones are excluded (tested by changing them).
fingerprint.thresholds: all pairs >= 4 groups / 2 silhouette; same country >= 5 / 3; same country comparable size (rows within 15 %) >= 6 / 3 (GER-2 vs GER-3); same country same archetype must differ in roofs and stands (no such pair among the prototypes). Standards and neutral venues differ from every prototype in >= 7 groups (>= 4 silhouette).

budgets.note: Measured on the generated meshes for every distinct venue design (73) in the offline harness, not GPU numbers. drawCalls = stadium slot meshes + 2 per supporter block + 4 LED boards + apron (contracts: stadiumPlusSupportersDrawCalls).
budgets.generatedTextures: +2 club atlases (256x128 RGBA32 with mips, ~0.35 MB together) per presented match on top of the existing stadium textures; no texture for figures (vertex colours).
budgets.unmeasured: BuildStadium wall time, delivered GPU frame rate, WebGL shader variant compile time and memory: Root measures (4070 Chrome/Edge, Pixel 9 Pro XL reduced).

visibility.contractConflict: contracts.json supporters.visibility asks for both blocks on screen in >= 95 % of live frames in the default follow camera. With end blocks this is geometrically impossible: the follow camera (near 60) frames about +-35 deg horizontally and only the far stand plus the end of the half where the ball is; at the centre spot neither end is in frame. Measured on a uniform ball grid: each block 36-48 % of positions (whole pitch), 98-100 % while play is in its half (|x| >= 10 m). StadiumSupportersTests gates the own-half share (>= 95 %) and reports the whole-pitch share; Root measures the recorded match. Placing ultras on the far long stand instead would contradict the authored end blocks (ultras behind the goals), so it was not done.
visibility.design: Visitors' corners are authored and derived into the FAR corner of their end (left of x-, right of x+ as seen from the pitch), because the follow camera shows far corners and rarely near ones (a near-corner default measured 53 % own-half visibility and was corrected).

// Stadium prototype gallery (StadiumGalleryDiagnostics; needs a graphics device): -d6output <folder> [-d6label <name>] [-d6only <fixture substring>].
public static void StadiumGallery(){string repo=null,message=null;bool ok=false;try{repo=Repo();if(SystemInfo.graphicsDeviceType==UnityEngine.Rendering.GraphicsDeviceType.Null)throw new InvalidOperationException("Stadium gallery needs a graphics device");ProbeWebBuild.Configure(repo);UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(Scene);message=StadiumGalleryDiagnostics.Run(repo,Arg("-d6output"),Arg("-d6label","prototype"),Arg("-d6only"));ok=true;}catch(Exception e){Debug.LogException(e);message=e.Message;}finally{if(repo!=null)ProbeWebBuild.Restore(repo);}Done(ok,message);}

decisionsAndDeviations: Absent presentation keeps the exact Release 130 stadium and builds no supporters (contracts.json absence rule; keeps the G0 baseline). Live pages always send a presentation.
Both-blocks >= 95 % follow visibility is unreachable for end blocks; gated on own-half visibility (>= 95 %, measured 98-100 %) and reported (36-48 % whole pitch).
Corners are authored per corner (Corners[4]) instead of per stand, because each corner joins two stands.

Schema extensions: Span (short stands), HeightOffset podiums, LandmarkPlace, landmark kinds twin-spires/tv-tower/windmill/gantry-crane, surroundings mountains, FlagPoles, optional tones; StadiumSlot.Haze appended; StadiumPiece.sides/detail.

Authored profiles keep TierCounts (size class), names, archetype and motif; their RoofSides follow the authored roofs (GER-5 ends roofed now) while the legacy catalogue keeps the Release 130 values for absent presentations.
Cup standards use one detail seed per country venue (identical structure for all cup clubs of a country); identity pattern, colours, banners and flags stay per club (pattern from Seed(club ID)).
Neutral venues use the arena's own colours for seats, walls and boards; equal end blocks share one layout seed so figures, flags and banners match in number; phases stay per club.
Visitors' sections are fenced with see-through rails (rake fences beside a 1.4 m empty strip, raised front rail); neutral blocks stay open.
Supporter colours are slightly muted versions of the club colours (crowd and cloth stay below the kits).
Windows also stay unlit whenever the look is Day (in addition to the windowLit threshold) and the glass emission is calmer by day.
limitationsAndRisks: Only 5 of 96 league grounds are individually authored; 31 legacy-derived and 60 league-standard grounds are reported as non-individual. The generator already covers every feature the full catalogue needs; the remaining work is authoring data after the prototype review.

Not rendered in Unity yet: proportions, colours, haze layering, crowd density and flag sizes are reasoned and previewed in software only; expect a tuning round after the Root gallery (all values are single constants).
Day look is only meaningful with lane B merged; until then the gallery's day requests show the night look (recorded per image as appliedLight).

In the default follow camera only the lower part of the far stand is in frame (roofs and skylines are cut off at zoom 60); structural identity there is carried by podiums, tiers, columns, ends and corners. Skylines and landmarks show in wide, sideline and behind-goal views.
General crowd away from the blocks remains the textured crowd strips; only the ultra blocks are geometry.
Figures receive shadows (fragment shadow lookup on ~5-17k triangles per block); if the Pixel run shows cost, receiveShadows can be turned off for figures in reduced quality.
Haze silhouettes (mountains, TV tower, cathedral) use the lit D6Env material; at night the floodlight key lights them slightly; tune colour or use the sky emission path after renders.
Visibility shares come from a synthetic ball grid, not the recorded match.
